name: Jellyfin Server Statistics Page
author: Grimmdev
description: Server statistics page for jellyfin, add to the left hand menu.

name: Jellyfin Providers
author: Snook-sudo
description: Add films and series from streaming providers directly to the home page.

name: Notification Framework
author: grimmdev
description: Send styled toast notifications. Includes a bell icon in the header with a popup notification history panel.

vars.name: Toast Position
vars.description: Where toasts appear on screen. Options: top-right, top-left, bottom-right, bottom-left.

vars.name: Max Visible Toasts
vars.description: Oldest toast is removed when this limit is exceeded.

vars.name: Default Toast Timeout (ms)
vars.description: How long each toast stays before auto-dismissing. Set to 0 for no auto-dismiss.

vars.name: Max Notification History
vars.description: How many notifications to keep in the bell panel history.

changes: Initial release. POST /send endpoint with all/user/session targeting. Styled toast UI with four types.

name: Left Menu Framework
author: grimmdev
description: A mod that cleans up the left menu.

name: Logo Replacer
author: grimmdev
description: A mod that replaces the jellyfin logo with whatever you want.

vars.name: Custom Logo URL
vars.description: Direct link to your custom logo image (PNG/SVG/WebP).

name: Player Versions
author: ShadowZer0
description: With a single click, you can switch between multiple stored versions of the same file (e.g., 4K Remux, 1080p BluRay, WEB-DL, Ger Dub, Eng Sub) without navigating through menus. Make sure to merge Movies and Episodes.

name: Episodes Coming Up
author: ShadowZer0
description: A custom tab for Jellyfin that opens a 'Coming Up' popup directly on the home screen — styled with a sleek glassmorphism effect to perfectly match the Ultrachromic theme.

name: Jellyfin Social
author: grimmdev
description: A social network for your Jellyfin server where users can share thoughts, recommendations and more.

name: KefinFrame
author: grimmdev
description: A comprehensive Jellyfin enhancement suite: per-user watchlist, skin/appearance switcher, custom home screen sections, enhanced keyboard search, and custom navigation links. Inspired by KefinTweaks, rebuilt natively for JellyFrame.

vars.name: Accent Color
vars.description: Primary highlight color used in the KefinFrame UI panels.

changes: Initial release. Features: per-user watchlist (bookmark toggle on all cards), skin/appearance switcher in header, custom home screen sections, enhanced search overlay (/ or Ctrl+K), custom nav links, settings panel with export/import/reset.

name: JellyAssistant
author: grimmdev
description: High-speed free AI chat via OpenRouter. Use :free models for no-cost chatting.

vars.name: Enable Library Read Access
vars.description: Allows the AI to read your library stats and latest items to provide personalized answers.

name: Smart Recommendations
author: grimmdev
description: An algorithmic recommendation engine based on your favorite genres and tags.

name: Jellyfin Wallpaper
author: grimmdev
description: Live and Static wallpaper for jellyfin, supports vimeo, direct links and also item id from your library to play that movie.

vars.name: Static Wallpaper URL
vars.description: URL to a static image (jpg, png, webp, etc.) to use as the homepage wallpaper. Leave empty for the built-in default.

vars.name: Live Wallpaper Source
vars.description: Vimeo URL (e.g. https://vimeo.com/439940966), a direct video URL (mp4/webm), or a Jellyfin item ID (32-char hex). Leave empty for the built-in default.

name: Meow
author: grimmdev
description: After a recent meme, I decided to turn jellyfin into a cat, every word becomes meow, warning do not use without being familiar with navigation.

name: Watch Queue
author: grimmdev
description: A personal watch queue. Add movies or episodes from any card or detail page, reorder them, and play in sequence or shuffle.

name: User Theme Selector
author: grimmdev
description: Allows individual users to override the server theme from their preferences menu.

vars.name: Themes JSON URL
vars.description: URL to a valid themes.json catalog.

name: Audio Studio
author: grimmdev
description: Feature complete audio studio for videos, EQ, custom EQ, volume booster.

name: Screensaver
author: grimmdev
description: After 30 minutes of idle, one of four screensaver designs, with user chosen styles.

name: Responsive Header Right Menu
author: grimmdev
description: Automatically moves crowded header icons into a slick, slide-out 'More Options' menu on smaller screens.

name: Jelly RPG
author: grimmdev
description: Turn your jellyfin into a role playing game.

vars.name: Theme Color
vars.description: The primary color for progress bars, stats, and highlights.

vars.name: Level Up Flash Color
vars.description: The color used for the massive LEVEL UP text on the screen.

vars.name: Global XP Multiplier
vars.description: Scale all XP gained globally (e.g., 1.5 for 50% more XP).

vars.name: Base XP (Movie)
vars.description: Base experience points rewarded for finishing a Movie.

vars.name: Base XP (Episode)
vars.description: Base experience points rewarded for finishing an Episode.

vars.name: Daily Quest Count
vars.description: How many bounties a user receives each day (1 to 6).

name: Hot Library Heatmap
author: grimmdev
description: Posters emit a glow determined by all users watch history.

name: Community Ratings
author: grimmdev
description: Let every user rate media 0-10. Shows aggregate star ratings on all media cards (home, library, favorites) and a full interactive widget on detail pages.

name: Home App Layout
author: grimmdev
description: A layout framework for home page app/cards.

vars.name: Section Title
vars.description: What to name the visual layout header.

name: Home Page Editor
author: grimmdev
description: A visual editor for apps and the homepage.

name: Custom Synthetic Tabs
author: yourname
description: Adds a custom tab to the UI that loads a synthetic HTML page with its own isolated JS/CSS.

vars.name: Tab Name
vars.description: The label shown on the custom tab.

vars.name: Tab Top Offset
vars.description: Adjust this based on your theme to place the page perfectly under the top bar.

vars.name: Custom HTML Content
vars.description: The raw HTML, CSS, and JS to load inside the synthetic page.
vars.default: Welcome to your custom page!

name: Media Bar
author: grimmdev
description: A featured content slideshow bar on the Jellyfin home page. Showcases backdrop images, logos, ratings, genres, and plot summaries for your media with auto-advancing slides, navigation arrows, and play/detail/favourite buttons. Configure a playlist ID for curated content or let it pick from your latest additions automatically.

vars.name: Playlist ID
vars.description: Jellyfin item ID of a playlist to use as the source for the bar. Leave blank to use the latest additions from your library.

vars.name: Manual Item IDs
vars.description: Comma-separated list of Jellyfin item IDs to feature. Ignored if Playlist ID is set.

vars.name: Number of Items
vars.description: How many items to show in the bar (1–20).

vars.name: Slide Interval (ms)
vars.description: How long each slide is shown before auto-advancing. Default is 8000 (8 seconds).

vars.name: Shuffle Items
vars.description: Randomise the order of items each time the bar loads.

name: Meilisearch Search
author: grimmdev
description: Replaces Jellyfin's native search with Meilisearch. Keeps the index in sync automatically via item events. Requires an external initial bulk index for large libraries.

vars.name: Meilisearch URL
vars.description: Base URL of your Meilisearch instance, e.g. http://localhost:7700

vars.name: Meilisearch API Key
vars.description: Your Meilisearch master key or a search-capable API key.

name: Are you still watching?
author: grimmdev
description: Shows an 'Are you still watching?' prompt after a period of inactivity during playback. If not dismissed, the player exits automatically. Fully configurable timing, text, and colours.

vars.name: Idle Time (minutes)
vars.description: How many minutes of uninterrupted playback before the prompt appears. Default is 180 (3 hours).

vars.name: Prompt Timeout (seconds)
vars.description: How many seconds the prompt stays on screen before the player exits. Default is 60.

vars.name: Prompt Message
vars.description: The heading text shown on the prompt overlay.

vars.name: Button Label
vars.description: Text on the continue watching button.

vars.name: Button Color
vars.description: Background color of the continue watching button.

vars.name: Text Color
vars.description: Color of the prompt heading and countdown text.

vars.name: Overlay Background
vars.description: Background color of the overlay. Use rgba() for transparency, e.g. rgba(0,0,0,0.85).

name: Media Request
author: grimmdev
description: Adds a Request Media button to the left-hand navigation menu. Users can submit requests for movies, TV shows, music, or any configured media type. Requests are stored server-side and optionally forwarded to a webhook (Discord, Slack, custom).

vars.name: Menu Button Label
vars.description: Text shown on the navigation menu button.

vars.name: Accent Color
vars.description: Color used for the submit button and input focus ring.

vars.name: Media Types
vars.description: Comma-separated list of request types shown in the dropdown. e.g. Movie, TV Show, Music, Anime, Other
vars.default: Movie, TV Show, Music, Anime, Other

vars.name: Webhook URL
vars.description: Optional. POST each new request to this URL (Discord, Slack, or any HTTP endpoint). Leave blank to disable.

vars.name: Webhook Secret
vars.description: Optional. If set, signs the webhook payload with HMAC-SHA256 and adds an X-Hub-Signature-256 header.

name: Vision (X-ray alt)
author: grimmdev
description: An alternative to amazon's X-ray feature, presents information from wikipedia.

name: Video Tuner
author: grimmdev
description: Adds brightness, contrast, saturation, sharpness and denoise controls to the Jellyfin video player.

name: Bluelight Filter
author: grimmdev
description: A button to your video player to filter bluelight.

name: Random Movie
author: grimmdev
description: Roll the dice and pick a random movie.

name: Seasonal Effects
author: grimmdev
description: Decorate your jellyfin with seasonal effects.

name: Rating Badges
author: grimmdev
description: Rating badges for imdb, and rotten tomatoes.

name: New Arrivals Badge
author: grimmdev
description: A custom badge for items to jellyfin, that shows newly added items.

name: Hover Details
author: grimmdev
description: A popup on hover for movie/show/episode details.

name: Video Screenshot
author: grimmdev
description: Adds a screenshot button to the video player, Supports single capture and auto-screenshot mode at a configurable interval.

name: 360 VR Player
author: Mix1C
description: A custom 360 degree video player.

name: 3D Movie Posters
author: grimmdev
description: 3d movie posters that rotate with your mouse.

name: Weather Icon
author: grimmdev
description: Shows the current weather in the header.

name: Time Icon
author: grimmdev
description: Shows the current time in the header.

name: Active Session Counter Icon
author: grimmdev
description: Shows the active content watching sessions.

name: Latency Icon
author: grimmdev
description: Shows the current latency in the header.

name: Battery Icon
author: grimmdev
description: Shows the current battery in the header.

name: Recent Movie Pills
author: grimmdev
description: Shows pills that filter recent movies on the home page.

name: JellyChat
author: grimmdev
description: Jellyfin chat, directly in real time with other users.

name: Jellyfin Episodes Ratings Grid
author: Damocles-fr
description: Display the IMDb episodes ratings heatmap grid on Jellyfin TV Series pages. The userscript adds the grid to TV Shows pages between Seasons and Cast, inside a drop-down section that stays closed by default to avoid spoilers.

name: Multiview Livestream
author: Grimmdev
description: Multiview livestream functionality, with audio focus.

name: Weather App Homepage
author: Grimmdev
description: A homepage app that adds the weather forecast.

name: My Pet App Homepage
author: Grimmdev
description: A homepage app that adds a pet to take care of.

name: Server Health App Homepage
author: Grimmdev
description: A homepage app that adds server health.

name: Coin Flip App Homepage
author: Grimmdev
description: A homepage app that adds fun.
